★ Request
Rulership (Summer Uniform) sneaks in from off-screen.

■ Stage Direction
Enthusiastically

Indeed... The true Seer was the one unanimously lynched yesterday.
And I, whom you all trusted so deeply, was the fake claim all along... the Werewolf――!

No, that should be my line.
Luck certainly favored me this time around.

What's this, still working?
Even though it's your charge's rest day...

Let's see... "Are you free right now?" ...No, that makes it sound like I've got nothing to do.
"What are you doing?" ...Mmm? Won't that make them wonder "why are you asking?"...

I must protect my dignity at all costs... It could undermine my Trainer's morale.
This calls for a tactical plan――

Still, being overly casual might be a problem...
It's easy enough for me to take the first step, but...

Come, my brethren! Reveal yourselves! Bare your fangs!
From here on, it's Power Play――!

She gives a confident smirk.
I'm not quite sure what it's all about, but Rulership seems as full of energy as ever today!

Rulership was standing right in front of the door.
Had she just arrived at the trainer's office?

Let's reset and devise a concrete move.
Now then, how should I naturally close the distance between us...?

Next time, however, I shall manipulate everything.
No matter the board state, I am the one who holds the initiative!

I think I'll go buy a coffee and take a short break.
With that in mind, I step out into the hallway――

Heh... Hehehe...
Fascinating, I accept your challenge!

Phew... Time for a break.
Oh, right, is Trainer... not logged in?

How did I usually handle things at times like this?
Uhhh... Mmmmm...?

Heh... It seems my actions from earlier
inadvertently served as the catalyst.

Wait, do I even need an excuse to meet when there's no business... Yes, I do. Of course I do!
Good communication is vital for racing, isn't it?!

"Wait, what's with you all of a sudden?
I had no idea you were that kind of person, Ruler..."
Mogyahhhh―――!!

Heheheh... Hahahahaha...!
Good grief, to think you would dance along so perfectly to my tune.

My entire "Cool Domi-san" persona will be shattered!
Everything I've built up so far will...!

Wha――?!
...No—by all means, I don't mind at all?

What do you mean 'what is it'? I was simply passing by.
Hahaha, surely you could tell just by looking. ...Well then, excuse me.
Trainer! Heheh, look who's heeeere♪

(Just think about it. If someone like me went running over
like a little lapdog without even having business with them...)
Whoa! T-Trainer... Ry?!

I got worried about Rulership, so when I went
to visit her stronghold, she was utterly shocked.

—That afternoon, I was tackling a mountain of paperwork.
Since today was Rulership's rest day, I wanted to clear it all away.

That was close...! What would've happened
if they caught me pacing around aimlessly?!

And so, she let me inside.
From the looks of it... my worries seemed completely unfounded.

(...Looks like they're working after all.
Hmmmmm... what to do... Knock? No way...)

—Two nooses left, and every member of the Werewolf faction survives...
Heh heh, an effortless clean sweep. Thanks for the game~

I'll increase our contact while keeping the upper hand.
My goal is... 'a relationship where we can meet even without business'!

That would be soooo painful...!!
No way! Way too lame! I'd never recover from that!!
